print(csv_data)

lines = [l for l in lines if l and not l.startswith('(.venv)')]
header = lines[0]
print("Header:", header)

james_won = []
sofia_won = []
james_total = 0
sofia_total = 0

    cols = line.split(',')
    if len(cols) >= 7:
        deal_id = cols[0]
        rep = cols[1]
        region = cols[2]
        product = cols[3]
        amount = cols[4]
        close_date = cols[5]
        status = cols[6].strip().lower()
        
        if status == 'won':
            if rep == 'James Okafor':
                james_won.append((deal_id, region, product, amount, close_date))
                james_total += int(amount)
            elif rep == 'Sofia Delgado':
                sofia_won.append((deal_id, region, product, amount, close_date))
                sofia_total += int(amount)

print("\n=== James Okafor - Won Deals ===")
for d in james_won:
    print(f"  {d[0]} | {d[2]} | ${int(d[3]):,} | {d[4]} | {d[1]}")
print(f"  Total: {len(james_won)} deals | Combined Q3 Value: ${james_total:,}")

print("\n=== Sofia Delgado - Won Deals ===")
